quests.name: Wolves at the Gate
quests.goal: Slay 5 wolves on the road west of Oakhaven
quests.offer: Wolves have been taking our sheep, and last week one bit a child. A pack hunts west along the barrow road. Cull five of them and the village will sleep easier.
quests.done: You have the look of a proper hunter. Take this, with my thanks.

quests.name: The Rift Stones
quests.goal: Cross into the Shadow (R) at the Whispering Stones and slay 6 creatures
quests.offer: The old stones northwest of here hum at night. My grandmother called them the Rift: a door to the Shadow realm. Something is leaking through. Stand among the stones, press R to cross over, and cut down what lives there.
quests.done: So the Shadow is real, and it is hungry. You have bought us time.

quests.name: The Barrow King
quests.goal: Descend into the Hollow Barrow and defeat the Barrow King
quests.offer: The dead walk because a king will not stay buried. His barrow lies west, beyond the wolves. End him, and bring back proof that he is quiet at last.
quests.done: The dead lie still. Oakhaven owes you more than we can repay.

quests.name: Warchief Grukk
quests.goal: Slay Warchief Grukk in the Goblin Warrens
quests.offer: Goblin raiders keep hitting our carts. They come from the Warrens to the south, and a warchief named Grukk leads them. Kill him and the raids stop.
quests.done: Grukk dead? Gods. Here, this was our watch fund. You earned it.

quests.name: Heart of Ashes
quests.goal: Destroy the Obsidian Golem deep in the Ashen Depths
quests.offer: There is a fire under the island, and something old tends it. The Ashen Depths lie far to the southwest. Smash the Obsidian Golem that guards it.
quests.done: The tremors have stopped. I did not think you would come back.

quests.name: Ashen Wings
quests.goal: Slay Vorthrax the Ashen atop Drakespire
quests.offer: Smoke has hung over Drakespire since the rift opened. Vorthrax sleeps there, and sleeping things wake. Take every potion you own. Then end the dragon.
quests.done: Then the age of the Ashen Drake is over. You are the legend now.

quests.name: Blood and Sand
quests.goal: Clear wave 5 in the Crimson Arena Wave Survival
quests.offer: Anyone can swing a sword at a wolf. The crowd wants to see you survive five waves. Do it and you earn a purse, plus a name worth shouting.
quests.done: The crowd chants your name. Take your winnings.

quests.name: Face Your Shadow
quests.goal: Win a Shadow Duel against your own double
quests.offer: My pit mages can call your shadow out of the Rift: your gear, your moves, your habits. Beat yourself and I will make you famous.
quests.done: You beat yourself. That is the hardest duel there is.

quests.name: Shadow Champion
quests.goal: Win 3 Shadow Duels in a row
quests.offer: One win is luck. Three in a row, each shadow stronger than the last, is a champion. Prove it.
quests.done: Champion. There is no other word for it.

npcs.name: Elder Maren
lines: The Shadow is not evil, child. It is only hungry. Remember that when you cross over.
Press R at the standing stones, and the world turns. I have seen it twice in my life.

npcs.name: Brynn the Merchant
lines: Coin for goods, goods for coin. I do not ask where you found it.

npcs.name: Guard Tomas
lines: Keep your blade sharp and your back to a wall. That is all the advice I have.
Dungeon mouths glow blue at the roadsides. Do not go in under-levelled. The depth is no joke.

npcs.name: Dorrin the Smith
lines: A good edge is worth more than a good story.

npcs.name: Kael, Arena Master
lines: Blood, sand and applause. What more could a hero want?

npcs.name: Villager
lines: Strange lights at the old stones lately.
My cousin saw a wolf as big as a calf.

npcs.name: Villager
lines: The arena folk are loud but they pay well.
Brynn sells a horse, if you can afford one. A horse makes the island feel small.

npcs.name: Farmhand
lines: Moon looks wrong some nights. Violet.
The Barrow King used to be a good man, they say.
